_readme: PAST PAPERS, MODEL PAPERS, MARKING SCHEMES AND REVISION PAPERS
READ THIS BEFORE ADDING ANYTHING.
A paper may be added to this file only if ONE of these is true:
1. RCF English created it;
2. the copyright holder has given permission to distribute it;
3. R. C. Fernando has personally approved its publication; or
4. it is linked (not copied) from Google Drive or from the official
website that publishes it.
WHAT R. C. FERNANDO HAS DECIDED ABOUT PROVINCIAL PAPERS
Sri Lankan provincial and zonal examination papers normally carry the
words 'All Rights Reserved' printed on them, and they circulate openly on
educational websites. R. C. Fernando has decided that papers set by a
PROVINCIAL DEPARTMENT, a ZONAL or DIVISIONAL office, or a SCHOOL may be
listed here, because this site LINKS to a file in Google Drive and never
hosts a copy of it.
PAPERS FROM PRIVATE INSTITUTES, ACADEMIES, TUITION CLASSES AND
PUBLISHERS MUST NOT BE LISTED. Their names are often not in the filename;
the publisher is printed on the paper itself. Every paper must be opened
and checked before it is added. Thondamanaru Thanu Publications, Oxford
Publications, Panacea English Class and Sumex mock papers were all found
this way and are excluded.
Always record the source printed on the paper. Never describe a
provincial, zonal or government paper as an RCF English creation.
FIELDS (only 'id', 'title' and 'type' are compulsory):
id             a short name with no spaces, e.g. ol-english-model-1
title          what the visitor sees
description    one or two sentences
subject        ol-english | ol-literature | al-literature | general-english
grade          e.g. 10                          (used by the grade filter)
examination    ol | al | school-term-test | provincial | model
level          e.g. Grade 11, Advanced Level
year           e.g. 2024
term           first | second | third            (school papers only)
paper          I | II                            (paper number)
type           past-paper | model-paper | marking-scheme | model-answer |
revision-paper | question-bank
province       the province, zone or school printed on the paper
sourceType     provincial | zonal | school       (used by the source filter)
answers        yes | no                          (is answer material listed?)
medium         english | sinhala | tamil
source         who produced it, exactly as printed on the paper
pages          number of pages, ONLY if you have counted them
thumbnail      assets/img/thumbs/your-picture.png
url            the Google Drive VIEW link
download       the Google Drive DOWNLOAD link
fileSize       e.g. 480 KB
copyright      Created by RCF English | Published with permission |
Linked from Google Drive | Linked from the official source
markingScheme  address of the marking scheme, if there is one
related        ["id-of-another-paper"]
published      false hides the record without deleting it
DRIVE LINK FORMAT (both tested and working without signing in):
view      https://drive.google.com/file/d/FILE_ID/view
download  https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=FILE_ID
After editing this file, run build.cmd.
